L59: ### Canine B-Cell Lymphoma Study
L60: 
L61: Now Enrolling Patients​
L62: 
L63: #### Study Overview
L64: 
L65: The primary objective of this study is to evaluate the safety and efficacy of an oral treatment for dogs newly diagnosed with B-cell lymphoma.
L66: 
L67: #### Eligibility Criteria
L68: 
L69:   * Dog is > 1 year old
L70:   * Dog is ≥ 22lbs ≤ 100 lbs
L71:   * Dog has been diagnosed with B-cell lymphoma and is treatment naive
L72: 
L73: #### Study Timeline
L74: 
L75:   * 3 months
L76:   * 10 clinic visits per patient
L77: ### Interested in this study?
L78: Reach out to a participating hospital to learn more!
L79:

L88:

L59: ### Osteosarcoma Vaccine Study
L60: 
L61: Now Enrolling Patients​
L62: 
L63: #### Study Overview
L64: 
L65: The primary objective of this study is to evaluate the efficacy of a novel vaccine as compared to standard of care (Carboplatin) following amputation as treatment for canine appendicular osteosarcoma.
L66: #### Eligibility Criteria
L67: 
L68:   * Dog is ≥ 1 year of age
L69:   * Dog is ≥ 44lbs
L70:   * Dog is in good general health with the exception of appendicular osteosarcoma
L71:   * Dog had cytologic and/or histologic confirmation of appendicular osteosarcoma
L72: 
L73: #### Study Timeline
L74: 
L75:   * 6-8 Months
L76:   * 10-12 clinic visits per patient
L77: 
L78: ### Interested in this study?
L79: Reach out to a participating hospital to learn more!
